# Connor Love

## Projects

- LoveUI: A production-ready component system with atomic components, sections, templates, and example apps for modern product interfaces.
- LoveChat: A full-stack AI chat platform with branching conversations, session chat, memory systems, file uploads, rich rendering, model routing, and web search.
- Lyceum: An AI-powered learning platform with personalized learning paths, interactive labs, progress tracking, reflections, and adaptive recommendations.
- LoveSans: A custom sans-serif typeface system designed for digital products, branding, and interface design.
- ConnorVault: A full-stack API key management and proxy platform for securing provider credentials, routing requests, tracking usage, and managing key lifecycles.
